counters.initialization: remaining.ruleUnits = deps.budgetLimits.ruleUnits; remaining.policyUnits = deps.budgetLimits.policyUnits; used values start at zero.
counters.unitCharge: Before exactly one rule or policy evaluation unit, test the corresponding remaining counter. If zero, perform no unit, decrement nothing, and take the exhaustion transition. Otherwise subtract exactly one using checked u64 subtraction and add exactly one to the corresponding used counter using checked u64 addition.
counters.exhaustion: The first failed charge ends evaluation deterministically. The coverageKey named by that charge is set to budget-exhausted; CoreCompletion is incomplete with deficiency budget-exhausted and an indeterminate policyOutcome. No later scripted unit or diagnostic is evaluated.
counters.overflow: Budget limit values above u64, negative integers, booleans, and floats reject before evaluate. Since used never exceeds its same-kind initial u64 limit, checked increment cannot overflow; any implementation-observed arithmetic failure is a contract fault and must not wrap, saturate, or continue.
counters.directSemanticEffect: Budget accounting directly changes only ExactCoverage by the declared first-failed-charge rule. The incomplete variant, deficiency, and indeterminate policy outcome are consequences derived from that Coverage; budget limits or usage never enter findings or evidence identity directly.

diagnosticsBuffer.initialization: empty records, nextOrdinal = 0u128, droppedCount = 0u128, capacity = deps.budgetLimits.diagnosticRecords
diagnosticsBuffer.emission: For each deterministic diagnostic candidate, assign current nextOrdinal then checked-increment nextOrdinal. If records.len < capacity, deep-copy the record into records and increment diagnosticRecordsAccepted; otherwise retain no record and checked-increment droppedCount and diagnosticRecordsDropped.
diagnosticsBuffer.ordering: Records preserve emission order exactly. No sorting, deduplication, replacement, sampling, or severity preference is permitted.
diagnosticsBuffer.truncation: The first capacity records are retained and every later record is dropped. capacity zero is the valid no-op diagnostics form.
diagnosticsBuffer.droppedCount: Exact count of all attempted emissions not retained. u128 is used because the sum of two independently bounded u64 evaluation domains can exceed u64.
diagnosticsBuffer.semanticNeutrality: Changing diagnostic capacity, diagnostic messages, retained records, dropped count, or AttemptMetadata cannot change the evidence projection, findings, Coverage, or policy outcome.

order: 1. run the rule stage under localEvaluationState's budget rules; obtain findings (or partialFindings) and the final ExactCoverage, INCLUDING any first-failed-charge rewrite of a coverageKey to budget-exhausted. Determine the variant and, if incomplete, the deficiency.
2. build PolicyDerivationInputV1 from the two committed arguments and those derived values. It contains no value produced by the policy stage.
3. derivationDigest = commit(record): one SHA-256 over the leaf frame, one over the outer frame.
4. run the policy stage; obtain the verdict.
whenAnImplementerComputesIt.noCycle: the record carries findings and exactCoverage, which are SIBLINGS of policyOutcome inside CoreCompletion, and never policyOutcome itself. There is no self-reference and no fixpoint. This is structural, not a convention: step 3 completes before step 4 begins, so the value cannot depend on anything step 4 produces.
whenAnImplementerComputesIt.theExhaustionPath: when the first failed charge ends evaluation, localEvaluationState.counters.exhaustion requires an incomplete completion with deficiency budget-exhausted and an INDETERMINATE policyOutcome. The policy stage did not run. derivationDigest is STILL computed, over the same record, and it still says what the policy WOULD have derived from. That is why PDD-02 and PDD-03 differ: POS-04 exhausts coverage:rule and POS-05 exhausts coverage:policy, so their ExactCoverage differs -- and POS-05 additionally carries a non-empty partialFindings.
whenAnImplementerComputesIt.cancelledAndFaulted: CoreCompletion::cancelled and ::faulted carry no policyOutcome, so no derivationDigest exists on those paths and none is computed. The encoder REFUSES to encode them (REJ-12).
